entries.content: Awarded <label style=color:var(--quaternaryColor)>B.S. in Computer and Information Science</label> from SUNY Old Westbury, with <label style=color:var(--importantColor)>Dean's List</label> honors.

I have a deep <label style=color:var(--importantColor)>passion</label> <label style=color:var(--quaternaryColor)>for Software Engineering</label>. Every day is another opportunity to learn something new.
Knowledgeable and practiced across a wide range of both old and recent technologies.
